meta.name: sync-public-docs
meta.description: Use when modifying public API in packages/core (types/global.ts, types/default.ts, index.ts, or package.json `exports` field), adding/renaming/removing props, changing default values, before publishing a new react-zmage version, or when the user says "sync docs" / "update public docs" / "propagate this change" / "同步文档" / "更新对外文档" / "准备发版". This skill coordinates four documentation destinations that drift independently — packages/core types & defaults, packages/home docs sections + schema, docs/llms.txt, and README.md / AGENTS.md. The repo has TS-level guards on type imports, but defaults values, natural-language docs, README/AGENTS prose, llms.txt, and playground snippets have NO automatic guards — this skill IS the documented process that closes that gap. Trigger it aggressively whenever core's public surface changes; over-triggering is cheap, missed sync causes shipped doc drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同步公共 API 变更到所有文档位置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在修改核心 API 后需要自动更新多份文档
copy.tagline_en: Sync public API changes to all documentation destinations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically update multiple docs after modifying core API

howto.what: 安装后，当你修改 react-zmage 的公开 API（如类型、默认值、导出）时，Claude 会自动检查并同步四处文档：核心类型、官网文档、llms.txt 和 README。它会生成修改草稿，并行写入文件，最后运行测试确保文档与代码一致。
howto.when: 当你修改 packages/core 下的类型文件、默认值、index.ts 或 package.json 的 exports 字段，添加/重命名/删除属性，更改默认值，或说“同步文档”、“更新对外文档”、“准备发版”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我改了 Zmage 的默认缩放比例，帮我同步文档。
say.note: Claude 会诊断变更并更新所有相关文档。

say.text: 给 Zmage 新增了一个 prop，叫 lazyLoad，同步一下。
准备发版，检查文档是否同步。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整同步流程并给出发布就绪报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you modify react-zmage's public API (types, defaults, exports), Claude automatically checks and syncs four documentation destinations: core types, home docs, llms.txt, and README. It drafts changes, writes files in parallel, and runs tests to ensure docs match code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you modify type files, defaults, index.ts, or package.json exports in packages/core; add/rename/remove props; change default values; or say "sync docs", "update public docs", "propagate this change", "同步文档", "更新对外文档", "准备发版".

say_en.text: I changed the default zoom scale of Zmage, sync the docs.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose the change and update all relevant docs.

say_en.text: Added a new prop to Zmage called lazyLoad, sync it.
say_en.note: Claude will add prop docs, i18n keys, and playground controls.

say_en.text: Ready to release, check if docs are synced.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full sync flow and give a release-ready report.
